in_marathi.name: Nalinish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nalinish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the words 'nalina' and 'isha', Nalinish signifies one who is as beautiful as a lotus.

in_bengali.name: Nalinish
